title: How to Inspect Security and Filtering Evidence
overview: Help a reviewer support the Inspect Security and Filtering Evidence step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Review visible firewall, endpoint-security, VPN, proxy, and browser warning messages for the affected destination or application. Record any blocked connection, certificate, authentication, or policy event. Do not disable security software or change managed policies.
common_indicators: Record the observed result and return to the originating workflow.

quiz.question: What should you do after completing this support step?
answers: Record the result and return to the workflow
quiz.correct_answer: Record the result and return to the workflow
